name: Analyze Plugin Example
description: Example code for providing your own Analyze plugin.
project_description: Analyze Plugin Example (machine name analyze_plugin_example) is a developer-reference submodule of Analyze. Its README states it should not be installed on a live site but used as a copy-paste starting point for writing your own Analyze plugin. It ships one worked plugin, Example (id "example"), in src/Plugin/Analyze/Example.php, extending Drupal\analyze\AnalyzePluginBase. The class demonstrates every hook point of the Analyze plugin API: a renderSummary() that returns an analyze_table (max three rows), a renderFullReport() that returns an analyze_gauge, isApplicable() scoped to article nodes, an access() check, and extraSummaryLinks() adding a custom link. It defines no routes, services, permissions or configuration of its own and depends only on analyze.
